text_block_list.text: At the dance studio—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"I couldn't make it to the last lesson, so 
I wanted to go over the choreography 
before the next live."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I've memorized the song for now, so could 
you watch me from over there?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: And then, turn... and done.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Well? Was I running late at all?

Gold City's dancing was impeccably on beat 
and truly magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yep. Good to hear. Well then—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oguri-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I saw you heading into the studio just 
now. So, I went and changed into my gear 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: H-Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer. Answer me without 
changing your posture. What do you think 
Oguri-senpai means by this?
choice_data_list:
Did you come to learn the trick or 
something?
I heard she came to teach us dancing!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...! That is correct.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The dance instructor praised your sense as 
being top-notch. They even insisted that I 
learn from you—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But my method is literally just 
repetitive practice, you know? There isn't 
really a secret trick to it...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ! What kind of training method is that?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Um, I watched a video my friend sent me 
and practiced in my free time.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: So, the secret lies within that video...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...The video and the training methods were 
all completely normal.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, people tell me that a lot. That all 
my hard work is surprisingly ordinary."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No, but few are capable of steadily piling 
up such ordinary efforts day after day. I 
shall follow your example.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list:
They said your hard work is truly 
wonderful.
Your hard work is wonderful, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ......Shut up. I can hear you, idiot.

Afterward, Gold City briefly helped Oguri 
Cap with her dance practice.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...I heard you missed practice the other 
day and must be in a bind."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Memorizing dances all on your own is very 
difficult. So, I was wondering if I could 
help...

However, Gold City has only just finished 
her dance practice a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah. In that case, Oguri-senpai, would you 
mind doing it for me, please?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's totally fine. You can practice as 
many times as you need to.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I've been wanting to dance with 
you too, Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ! I see. In that case...

I became convinced that the endless stream 
of work offers for Gold City was due to 
far more than just her beauty.
